arkhaven.welcome: Welcome to Arkhaven! Open the quest book (key L or the button in your inventory) — the first quest explains everything.
effect.arkhaven.quiet.description: Hostile mobs ignore you until you strike.
effect.arkhaven.beast_trust.description: Young animals nearby grow up faster.
effect.arkhaven.clean_breath.description: Clears poison, nausea, wither and blindness from smog and acid rain.
effect.arkhaven.lead_blood.description: Slowly flushes radiation from your body.
tooltip.arkhaven.travelers_charm: In your inventory: enemies notice you at half the distance.
tooltip.arkhaven.star_carp: Found in water where a meteor has fallen.
arkhaven.trained: You are prepared for "%s" — it can now happen (the first one is a tutorial).
arkhaven.festival.spring.title: The Sowing Festival
arkhaven.festival.spring.chat: [Arkhaven] Spring is here! The Festivals chapter is open: the Sowing Festival and Spring Honey.
arkhaven.festival.summer.title: The Crafts Fair
arkhaven.festival.summer.chat: [Arkhaven] Summer! The Crafts Fair: show off your machines and race your planes.
arkhaven.festival.autumn.title: The Harvest Festival
arkhaven.festival.autumn.chat: [Arkhaven] Autumn! The Harvest Festival: a great dinner, pumpkins and young wine.
arkhaven.festival.winter.title: Winter Lights
arkhaven.festival.winter.chat: [Arkhaven] Winter! Winter Lights: deck the Haven with lanterns and go ice fishing.
arkhaven.guide.keeper.name: Haven Keeper
arkhaven.guide.keeper.line: Welcome! The Haven is safe: no enemies spawn here. The quest book explains everything — open it with L.
arkhaven.guide.marta.name: Marta the Innkeeper
arkhaven.guide.marta.line: Hungry? A knife, a pot and some veggies and you are a cook. The Kitchen & Tavern chapter awaits.
arkhaven.guide.luka.name: Luka the Gardener
arkhaven.guide.luka.line: The soil is generous. Plant seeds — and later grow iron right in your garden!
arkhaven.guide.vera.name: Vera the Zoologist
arkhaven.guide.vera.line: Bees, dragons, a hundred fish... I will help you befriend the beasts.
arkhaven.guide.gustav.name: Gustav the Mechanic
arkhaven.guide.gustav.line: Rotation is everything. Wheel, shaft, cog — and one day you will lift a citadel into the sky.
arkhaven.guide.iris.name: Iris the Mage
arkhaven.guide.iris.line: Magic loves good food and pretty flowers. Start with the novice book — I will guide you.
arkhaven.guide.dan.name: Dan the Guard Captain
arkhaven.guide.dan.line: It is quiet near the Haven. Want a fight? Head to the wilds or dungeons. But eat first and bring a shield.
arkhaven.guide.ada.name: Mayor Ada
arkhaven.guide.ada.line: Dreaming of your own town? Set up a settlers camp and citizens will come.
